test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**considered**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence “To forgive an injury is often (1)_______ to be a sign of weakness” needs a verb that means ‘thought’ or ‘regarded as’.
 
• The word **‘considered’** means ‘thought about or regarded as having a particular quality or characteristic’. (विचार किया गया / समझा गया)
 
• So, the correct phrase is: “To forgive an injury is often **considered** to be a sign of weakness.”
 
• Other options like ‘given’, ‘allowed’, or ‘granted’ do not fit grammatically or contextually in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Given (दिया गया):** Refers to something provided or offered, which doesn’t fit the sense of judgment or opinion here.
 
• **Allowed (अनुमति दी गई):** Means permitted or let happen, which is not suitable in the context of expressing opinion or belief.
 
• **Granted (स्वीकृत / प्रदान किया गया):** Means officially accepted or agreed upon; it doesn’t match the meaning of being ‘thought of as’.
